title: Relating to single-family homes held by corporate owners for rental purposes; requiring information by and registration of certain corporate owners; authorizing a fee and civil penalty.
last_action: Referred to Trade, Workforce & Economic Development

conflicts.code_text_excerpt:
Bed and breakfast (residence)
20.02.126 Bed and breakfast (residence).
"Bed and breakfast (residence)" means an owner-occupied or manager-occupied residential structure providing eight or fewer rooms for temporary, overnight lodging, with or without meals, for paying guests.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
